svg.aria-label: Not converted to SVG. The title is drawn, not set. Art Nouveau lettering of this kind is built to its own line: the letters of 'Brindlewick Village Fete' vary in width and slope to fill the arc, the terminals grow into the surrounding foliage, and the whole is part of the ornamental frame rather than a typeface applied to it. No face can stand in for it. The frame itself is continuous with the lettering, so the artwork cannot be cut out from behind the words either. Measured, the solver rejects 63 bands against the 22 it keeps and cannot align the copy better than a mean cost of 1.11.
